brief_title: Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Combination Treatment With DW1501-R1+DW1501-R2 Versus DW1501-R1 or DW1501-R2+DW1501-R3 in Patients With Hypertension and Dyslipidemia

primary_outcomes.measure: Change of MSSBP(Mean Sit Systolic Blood Pressure) from baseline
Change of LDL-C(Low Density Lipid Cholesterol) from baseline

brief_summary: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blinded, Double-dummy, Phase 3 Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Combination Treatment with DW1501-R1+DW1501-R2 Versus DW1501-R1 or DW1501-R2+DW1501-R3 in Patients with Hypertension and Dyslipidemia

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults both male and female who are ≥19,\<80 years old
* at screening, 140mmHg≤ SBP\<180mmHg \& 90mmHg≤ DBP\<110mmHg \& LDL-C≤250mg/dL \& triglyceride\<400mg/dL

Exclusion Criteria:

* at screening, the difference BP of one-side arm is SBP ≥ 20mmHg and DBP ≥ 10mmHg
* secondary hypertension or secondary dyslipidemia
* patients who have uncontrolled diabetes melitus, hyper/hypothyroidism or cardiac disease
* women who are pregnant or lactating
